items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: So, my brother -- Bill and Floyd and myself. We was the three brothers in the McRae Brothers Band

ctx.x: Because the clarinet is an instrument -- that would be your natural double, you know. Come out

to be your double. The double on the flute didn't come till later and I never did get to (inaudible) the flute. I went to the bass clarinet. My double was bass. Was a E-flat (inaudible) soprano, bass clarinet, tenor, bass sax and alto. When we -- my brother built his band and decided when they were working around Philly, decided that -- he got together with a lot of musicians out of Baltimore. At that time in the early 20's, '28 it was a lot of good musicians around Philly. And Baltimore was turning out some good…
